entities.name: Sothera
entities.description: A former sun and current supervoid at the center of the Sothera system in the Edge.

entities.name: Kav
entities.description: The only species native to Sothera, who emigrated from their world.

entities.name: Pinnacle
entities.description: Came to Sothera, built an FTL outpost and opened the system.

entities.name: Monoists
entities.description: Induced Sothera's collapse into a supervoid.

entities.name: Celestial Palatinate
entities.description: Fights to re-ignite the star with horizon javelins.

entities.name: Infinite Guideline
entities.description: An eternity column FTL outpost built by Pinnacle.

events.summary: Absorbing aether from a cloud called the Garden, Sothera becomes a red giant and collapses, scouring its nearest planets.
events.quote: becoming a red giant , and eventually ruptured her bounds and collapsed

events.summary: Horrified at the coming catastrophe, the Kav begin a species-wide project to emigrate.
events.quote: the Kav embarked on a species-wide project to emigrate from their world

events.summary: Pinnacle comes to Sothera, builds Infinite Guideline and opens the system to the Edge.
events.quote: Pinnacle came to Sothera, constructed an FTL outpost

events.summary: The Monoists induce Sothera's quiet collapse into a supervoid.
events.quote: inducing its quiet collapse into a supervoid

relations.note: Opposed over collapsing or re-igniting the star.
relations.quote: while the Celestial Palatinate fights them
